subject_line: Featuring the story behind Finding Eden
email_body:
Hi Kel,

I noticed that your Finding Eden series, a later-in-life women's fiction romance of hope, healing and second chances, is rolling out new installments this autumn, and that Salt Flower Bay has grown to six books. Building a world that readers keep returning to across so many books is a real accomplishment.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

The option I believe would suit Finding Eden best is a short book trailer with a few promotional reels. If a trailer or reels for the series is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, and it would be a completely optional add-on, separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Finding Eden best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
